funding.supported_assets_note: Stablecoin account (USDT deposits; other assets swapped on deposit) with fiat on-ramps per region (USD ACH/wire, EUR SEPA, GBP FPS, MXN SPEI, BRL PIX, COP Bre-B). Account services 'powered by Bridge' (Bridge Building Inc. US / Bridge Building Sp. z o.o. EEA / Bridge Building Limited elsewhere). The site states 'Plasma One does not custody your assets' but the mechanism is not documented on the pages read; custody left unknown.

variants.region_label: Global (EEA, UK, 31 US states and others; no positive country list published)

eligibility.nationality_restrictions_note: The countries article is written at ID-document level: documents from the 7 excluded countries 'are not supported'; documents from BY, CN, IN, IQ, IL, MM, NP, NI, TR, VN, NG, LK may fail but residence in a supported country with proof of address may still allow eligibility.
eligibility.usage_note: No positive list of supported countries is published: the official countries article (last updated 2026-05-11) names only unsupported countries, 31 supported US states (not WA, AZ) and comprehensive-sanctions jurisdictions. EEA and UK availability is implied only by the contracting entities (Bridge Building Sp. z o.o. for EEA residents; UK disclaimer page) and by EUR SEPA / GBP FPS rails. Marketing '180+ countries' refers to Visa acceptance, not eligibility. A separate fiat-rails article (2026-09-18) lists 25 further countries/territories without fiat deposit or withdrawal (incl. JP, TN, DZ, LB, IQ, AF) — not an account exclusion, so not modelled here.

kyc.stages_note: Identity verification (automated, third-party provider not named, up to 5 minutes) before a card can be activated: full legal name, date of birth, country, residential address; passport / national ID / photo ID (original document); liveness check by short video movement capture; proof of address issued within 3 months only in certain countries (not listed). Under-18s rejected. Human review of automated outcomes can be requested.

access.note: Homepage tier table: card cost '$0' and 'Free'. Lite help article: annual cost 'shown in the app for your region'; where a Lite fee applies, accounts created before it took effect stay free. Modelled as free, status contradictory.

fees.conditions: Virtual card activation: in most regions a $10 deposit is required (stated as 'not a fee', stays spendable); in some regions a $10 card fee applies instead, shown in the app before activation. Modelled as the least favourable case. Physical card not available on Lite.
Lite article: annual cost 'shown in the app for your region' — no amount published; homepage says $0.
Plasma FX markup +1% on card spend in a non-account currency, plus the Visa network FX fee stated as '~1%'. Modelled as 2% in total (approximate network component).
No ATM fee or allowance stated on any page read; ATM withdrawals are listed only as excluded from cashback.

Stablecoin/crypto deposit: Plasma fee 0.15%–0.75% (modelled at the top of the range) plus network, bridge and swap fees shown in the app. Fiat on-ramp instead: EUR SEPA $0.50, GBP FPS $0.50, USD ACH $1, USD wire $15 per deposit on Lite. Additional fees above $250,000 deposits/month.
Bank withdrawal (off-ramp) on Lite: 1% + rail fee for EUR SEPA, GBP FPS, USD wire, MXN, BRL; USD ACH 0.75% + ACH fee; COP 1% + $1.

evidence.title: Plasma One Rewards Addendum (effective 26 September 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Effective September 26, 2026. Card issued by Rain under a Visa licence; accounts by Bridge (Bridge Building Inc. / Sp. z o.o. for EEA / Limited). Cashback accrues in USD, paid in XPL or Spending Credit; rates, caps, lock amounts and prices 'in the Help Center'. Exclusions listed. Lite free; Core by annual USD fee or 12-month XPL lock; Platinum by XPL lock only. 18+, ID verification.

evidence.title: Comparing Lite, Core and Platinum (help centre, 18 Sep 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Directory article pointing to the tier, cashback, fees, cards and perks articles; states that rates, amounts, limits and perks are 'the parameters currently in effect' and may change prospectively under the Rewards Addendum.

evidence.title: How the Plasma One tier system works (help centre, 23 Sep 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Lite free ($10 deposit to activate the virtual card in most regions, $10 card fee in some regions); Core $199/year or lock 20,000 XPL for 12 months; Platinum lock 100,000 XPL for 12 months ('currently'), no USD option. Locks cannot be unlocked early. Base cashback up to 2%/3%/4%; AI 5%/10%; airline 10% (Platinum). Reverts to Lite if not renewed; no manual downgrade.

evidence.title: How does Lite work? (help centre)
evidence.excerpt: Annual cost 'shown in the app for your region'; accounts created before a regional Lite fee took effect stay free. Cashback in XPL: 2% on the first $500 of monthly spend, 0.1% above; weekly payouts (Thursdays), pending period. $10 deposit (most regions) or $10 card fee (some regions) to activate. 1 virtual card included; physical card not available on Lite. Referral 0.25% for 3 months.
evidence.contradiction_note: Lite's annual cost is regional and 'shown in the app' while the product page states '$0' — modelled as free with status contradictory.

evidence.title: How does Core work? (help centre, 18 Sep 2026)
evidence.excerpt: $199 per year or lock 20,000 XPL for 12 months. Cashback in XPL: 3% first $1,000/month, 2% $1,001–$2,000, 1% $2,001–$3,000, 0.25% above. AI merchants: 5% first $250, 4% $251–$500, 1% above. Referral 1% for 3 months. Up to $8/month ChatGPT Go rebate. Up to 2 free virtual cards; 1 free physical card ('coming soon'); Visa Signature; priority support.

evidence.title: How does Platinum work? (help centre, 18 Sep 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Lock 100,000 XPL for 12 months — 'promotional rate that rises to 150,000 XPL after the first 30 days from launch'. Cashback in XPL: 4% first $3,000/month, 3% to $10,000, 2% to $15,000, 1% above. AI: 10% first $500, 5% to $1,000, 1% above. Airline: 10% first $500. Referral 1% for 6 months; 'Platinum Referral Cashback Boost' 3% for 90 days or $300. $20 + $20/month AI rebates; Priority Pass.
evidence.contradiction_note: Still describes the 3% Platinum Referral Cashback Boost, which the referral article (23 Sep 2026) and the Rewards Addendum (26 Sep 2026) say is replaced by a flat $300 upgrade bonus for registrations on or after 26 Sep 2026. Lock amount 100,000 'rising to 150,000' vs tier-system article '100,000 currently'.

evidence.title: What are the fees on Plasma One? (help centre, undated — 'updated over 2 weeks ago')
evidence.excerpt: FX on card spend: Plasma markup Lite +1%, Core +0.5%, Platinum 0%; Visa network FX ~1% (Lite, Core), none on Platinum. On-ramp per deposit (Lite/Core/Platinum): USD ACH $1/$0.50/$0.50, USD wire $15/$15/$10, GBP FPS and EUR SEPA $0.50/$0.40/$0.30. Off-ramp: SEPA, FPS 1%/0.25%/0.10% + rail fee; USD wire 1%/0.5%/0.2%. Stablecoin deposit: 0.15%–0.75% + network fees. No ATM figures.

changelog.reason: Initial record from 13 official pages (product page, Rewards Addendum, 11 help-centre articles) read by the unattended research run on 2026-11-03. Single read; second read ≥ 24 h later required before publication. Country list unknown (no positive list published), ATM fee unknown on all tiers, Lite annual cost and Platinum lock amount contradictory between pages.

Second independent read on 2026-11-04 (fetcher, 25 h after the 2026-11-03 first read) of all 13 evidence pages: every material value confirmed — issuer Rain (Visa Principal Member) / Bridge entities incl. Bridge Building Sp. z o.o. for the EEA; Lite free with $10 activation deposit (or $10 card fee in some regions) and annual cost 'shown in the app for your region'; Core $199 per year or 20,000 XPL locked 12 months; Platinum 100,000 XPL locked 12 months ('rises to 150,000 after the first 30 days from launch' still shown); cashback bands 2 %/0.1 % – 3/2/1/0.25 % – 4/3/2/1 %; AI 5/4/1 % and 10/5/1 %; airline 10 %; FX markup 1 %/0.5 %/0 % plus Visa ~1 % (none on Platinum); on-ramp/off-ramp fee tables, stablecoin deposit 0.15–0.75 %, card counts and delivery fees, KYC documents, exclusion lists all unchanged; no ATM fee published anywhere. Addendum still effective 2026-09-26. NOT published: eligibility remains 'unknown' (still no positive country list; EEA/UK implied only by contracting entities and rails) and Lite access remains 'contradictory' ($0 on the product page vs regional cost in the app). Minor: the fiat-rails article lists 26 entries without fiat rails (the first read counted 25; Gaza Strip and West Bank are separate entries) — not modelled, excerpt count only.

editorial.summary: Stablecoin account with a Visa card issued by Rain, run by Plasma (not a regulated institution) with Bridge entities for the US, the EEA and the rest of the world. Cashback is paid in the XPL token: 2% (Lite, first $500/month), 3% (Core, $199/year or 20,000 XPL locked), 4% (Platinum, 100,000 XPL locked), stepping down above the monthly bands. FX is 1%/0.5%/0% plus Visa's ~1% on the two lower tiers. No official country list and no ATM fee is published.
good_for: Spending USDT-funded balances with a tiered XPL cashback and no FX fee on Platinum
Users who already hold XPL and accept a 12-month lock to unlock Core or Platinum
Heavy spending on AI subscriptions (5–10% category cashback) and on partner airlines (Platinum)
not_for: Anyone who needs a published list of eligible countries before applying — only exclusions and US states are stated
Users who want cashback in fiat or a stable asset: payouts are in XPL (or revocable Spending Credit), converted at payout price
ATM users: no ATM fee or allowance is published anywhere read
watch_outs: Eligibility status is unknown: the countries article names only unsupported countries and US states; EEA/UK service is implied by the Bridge contracting entities and SEPA/FPS rails, not stated.

Lite is '$0' on the product page but its annual cost is 'shown in the app for your region' in the help centre; a $10 deposit or (in some regions) a $10 card fee is needed to activate the virtual card.

Platinum's lock amount is stated as 100,000 XPL 'currently' and as an introductory amount rising to 150,000 XPL 30 days after launch; locked XPL earns nothing, cannot be unlocked early and 'may lose' value to zero.
Physical cards are 'coming soon' per the help centre although the product page advertises them; only virtual cards are modelled.
The Platinum article still describes a 3% referral boost that the Rewards Addendum (26 Sep 2026) replaced with a $300 upgrade bonus; the Addendum governs.
Yield ('up to 6%') comes from third-party DeFi vaults with stated risk of total loss; it is not a card feature and is not modelled.
FX modelled as Plasma markup plus Visa's '~1%' network fee (approximate); top-up modelled at the top of the 0.15–0.75% range.
